Terms and consent
1. Fees are payable monthly in advance and are due whether or not a child attends every session.
2. A place is only confirmed once the registration fee is paid and the office has issued a written offer.
3. Children must attend punctually and in the required dress. Repeated lateness may result in the place being reviewed.
4. Absences must be reported to the office before the start of the lesson.
5. Parents are responsible for dropping off and collecting children on time; children are not released to anyone not named on this form.
6. The madrassa follows its safeguarding, behaviour and anti-bullying policies, copies of which are available on request.
7. Serious or persistent misbehaviour may lead to suspension or withdrawal of the place.
8. Mobile phones and smart devices are not permitted during lessons.
9. Parents must inform the office in writing of any change of address, contact number, or medical need.
10. One month's written notice is required if a child is withdrawn.
